profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I build products with code - I am a full-stack and product-thinking software engineer. I believe technology should enable business outcomes and that technology is in service of the product. I strive to fully understand how the product will be used, and use that understanding to scope the the specifics of the technological implementation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: a new kind of prediction market, acquired by coinbase

positions.title: Senior Principal Backend Engineer
positions.description: I led overall development of the backend services and infrastructure supporting the Family iOS Ethereum wallet application. My work centered on a rearchitecture of services to support Ethereum Layer 2 chains and reduce our dependency on full-chain indexing. I joined Avara as part of the acquisition of Family, my prior employer.

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer
positions.description: I led development overall development of the backend services and infrastructure of Family (https://family.co/), an Ethereum wallet application for iOS with an emphasis on user experience. My work centered on the improvement and maintenance of our full-chain Ethereum index comprised of multiple terabytes of data. Family was acquired by Avara in November 2023.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Founded and led development. Sunspot alerts users in real-time when events occur in Ethereum Non-Fungible Token (NFT) marketplaces: snipe rare listings, build project sales bots, monitor floor prices and more.

- Architected real-time event ingest and processing pipeline dispatching Push, Discord, and Twitter notifications to users with sub-second latency.
- Developed fully automated NFT metadata indexing system utilizing self-hosted IPFS nodes to calculate rarity ranks of newly revealed collections in under 2 minutes on average.
- Deployed an Ethereum Smart Contract to take a referrer fee on application-sourced orders.
- Achieved 10k registered users, hundreds of daily active users, and over $30k in revenue.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack product engineer, specializing in product definition, architecture, and end-to-end implementation of minimum viable products and early-stage products. Additionally, I've also often worked in maintenance of legacy systems, rapidly scaling prototypes, and ongoing development of established products.

I prefer working full-stack, but can slot into a specific part of the stack if desired. My preferred set of technologies include React, React Native, TypeScript, Apollo / Relay, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and AWS, but the exact set of tools I reach for depends on the specifics of the product and business requirements.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
In leading software engineering at BigSpring, I was responsible for the ideation and implementation of technology in service of business initiatives as well as overseeing management and growth of the engineering department.

BigSpring's technology stack includes React, React Native, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, Node.js, TypeScript, Terraform, CircleCI, AWS Lambda, ECS, S3, Cloudfront, and API Gateway.

BigSpring is the only mobile learning platform that measures ROI from training. BigSpring has garnered 500,000 users across India, South East Asia, Africa, and the Americas in less than two years of launch. It is the platform of choice for Uber, United Technologies and others.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack engineer working on a location-centric art show guide feature within the primary application in partnership with BMW. Technologies utilized included React Native, React, TypeScript, Styled Components, GraphQL, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, and MongoDB.

I left the company after 5 months in order to join BigSpring in a role leading Software Engineering at the organization.

Artsy is an online platform for discovering, buying and selling fine art. Artsy's search engine and database draw connections and map relationships among works of art. Artsy aims to expand the art market to support more artists and art in the world.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack engineer working with clients ranging from small startups to Fortune 500 companies across diverse industries. Specialized in the development of minimum viable products utilizing technologies such as React Native, React, Redux, GraphQL, Node.js, TypeScript, Firebase, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud Platform.

Postlight designs and develops world-class digital experiences for global brands.

positions.title: Chief Information Officer, Web Developer
positions.description:
Led software engineering.

Architected and led development of iOS and Android mobile applications utilizing React Native. Implemented features including chat, recommendation systems, search, and music streaming.

Architected and led development of backend services used by the mobile applications. Technology stack included Koa (Node.js), Elasticsearch, Nginx, Redis, Golang, MongoDB.

Managed infrastructure and deployment pipelines for backend services running on GCP utilizing Kubernetes, Jenkins, and TravisCI.

positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.description: Crafted modern and responsive user interfaces for clients using AngularJS and React. Typically responsible for the entire front-end process, from creating mock ups, to implementation, to building out backend REST APIs on top of frameworks like Express (Node.js) and Django.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Built a new Content Management System in AngularJS communicating with a Django REST Framework API on the backend. Developed custom Angular directives allowing for user image uploading. Helped develop content for a professional development course with the intent of helping Computer Science educators better teach computer science to students. Full time during the period of June 2014 through August 2014, part time from August 2014 through January 2015.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description: Interact and help guide students through an introductory Computer Science course. Grade student submitted JavaScript programs for style and correctness, offer constructive feedback when appropriate.

honors.title: Google Code-In Grand Prize Winner
honors.description:
"Google Code-in (GCI) is a contest for pre-university students (e.g., high school and secondary school students) with the goal of encouraging young people to participate in open source. We work with open source organizations, each of whom will provide a list of tasks to be completed by student contestants. Tasks can be anything an organization needs help with, from bug fixes, to writing code, to user experience research, to writing documentation."

http://google-opensource.blogspot.com/2014/01/google-code-in-2013-drumroll-please.html

volunteerExperiences.description: Contributed over 40 commits and 8000 new lines of code to the RTEMS project as part of the Google Code-In.

Mentored a student whose project sought to resolve an unbounded priority inversion caused by a bug 		in the implementation of the priority inheritance algorithm for nested strict-order mutexes. See https://devel.rtems.org/wiki/GSoC/2015/NestedMutex for a project description.

projects.title: Literal - PDF Reader
projects.description:
Literal is a browser-based PDF reader with a minimal interface and modern feature set that will greatly enhance your e-reading experience.

Literal is available as an online reader via the website https://literal.io, as well as a Chrome extension (https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/literal-pdf-reader/aobcehhaeapnlhliodjobodhgmemimnl?authuser=1) and Firefox add-on (available on website).

Literal is built in React and leverages the open source PDF.js library for rendering PDF pages to canvas. The backend is a CouchDB app hosted on GCP with Kubernetes.
